claim: In lifx_controller an empty light cache (controller.lights) makes scheduled sequences 'complete' with zero fixtures driven and no error — there is no periodic re-discovery, so one failed startup discovery silently disables all scheduled lighting until a manual POST /api/lights/discover; grep 'Setting pattern' in /var/log/lifx-controller.log to confirm photons actually moved.
trigger: when scheduled lights fail to come on while schedules.json last_run and /api/health look healthy
when /var/log/lifx-controller.log shows 'Sequence completed' with no 'Setting pattern across N zones' lines
before trusting schedules.json last_run as proof that fixtures responded

claim: Pointer doc: learning_ee48213355fe3093 holds the empty-light-cache silent-blackout diagnosis — grep 'Setting pattern across N zones' in /var/log/lifx-controller.log to tell if a sequence actually drove fixtures, since schedules.json last_run only proves the scheduler fired.
trigger: when searching proj_lifx_controller for the silent-blackout or empty-cache incident history

claim: GET /api/health in lifx_controller reports the module-level scheduler_running flag in server.py that is set False at load and never updated, so the health endpoint always returns scheduler:false even when the scheduler is alive — verify liveness via fresh last_run timestamps in schedules.json instead.
trigger: when /api/health on lifx-controller returns scheduler:false
before using /api/health to verify the lifx scheduler is running

claim: lifx-controller reads schedules.json once at startup and rewrites it from the in-memory list after every schedule fire or group-skip, so direct edits while the service runs are silently overwritten — use the /api/schedules endpoints or stop-edit-start; sequences/*.json are loaded on demand and safe to edit directly.
trigger: before editing schedules.json while lifx-controller is running
when a manual schedules.json edit disappears after a schedule fires

claim: The lifx roof line fixture's canonical device label is "Roof line permanent " with a trailing space (burned into the LIFX device and mirrored in lights_cache.json and config/light_layout.json), so exact-match comparisons against the untrailing name silently miss it — pull names from controller.get_light_names() and never strip the space.
trigger: before writing string comparisons against LIFX fixture names
when a lookup for the 'Roof line permanent' fixture fails to match

claim: LIFX fixture IPs drift with DHCP, so a short fixture count from lifx-controller usually means lights_cache.json holds stale IPs — POST /api/lights/discover?timeout=8 rediscovers and rewrites the cache, and the 'test Set' bench being offline is normal.
trigger: when /api/health reports fewer lights than the expected fixture count
before a session that needs all LIFX fixtures to respond

claim: On LIFX dual-LED fixtures, setting saturation to 30-40 with a kelvin value blends the white and color emitters into pastel/champagne hues unreachable by RGB alone (e.g. sequences/champagne_80.json h:45 s:38 k:2500), while s:100 gives saturated symbolic colors with kelvin functionally inert.
trigger: before designing a new sequence file in sequences/ with a soft, pastel, or champagne look
when choosing saturation and kelvin values for a LIFX sequence

claim: lifx-controller holiday lighting uses the scheduler's group-override mechanism: a priority-100 schedule with group morning_on or evening_on and a date_range outranks the priority-0 defaults (IDs 5/6) via the fired_groups skip in _scheduler_loop, and outside the date_range the default runs unimpeded — add overrides with POST /api/schedules.
trigger: before adding a holiday or event lighting override to lifx-controller
when a default champagne_80 schedule fires during a holiday date_range

claim: lifx-controller holiday schedules use hardcoded date_range values, and Easter (schedule ID 10) and Thanksgiving (ID 15) move every year, so those two ranges must be manually updated each January via PUT /api/schedules/{id} — never by direct file edit.
trigger: when a new year begins and holiday lighting schedules need review
before verifying holiday date_ranges via GET /api/schedules IDs 10 and 15

claim: Pointer doc: a lifx session's end-of-session note stating its knowledge was already recorded as seven individual learnings (IDs 9b2, dc2, e98, d79, d02, 891, fa5) with nothing additional beyond them.
trigger: when searching proj_lifx_controller for that session's learning coverage

claim: The June patriotic lights 'switched back to white' because the season had only an evening override (the priority-0 morning champagne_80 ran daily) and patriotic_pastel_chase.json at s:40 reads as white on the outdoor roofline — fixed by adding morning override ID 22 and bumping red/blue bands to s:75; outdoor symbolic colors need saturation >=70 and themed seasons need both morning_on and evening_on overrides.
trigger: when a holiday season's lights revert to white in the morning
before creating a holiday override that should look themed all day
when an outdoor sequence's colors read as white from a distance

claim: lifx_controller was published 2026-06-01 to the private repo github.com/tlemmons/lifx-controller with secrets externalized to gitignored config/secrets.json and config/ai_settings.json and history scrubbed via git-filter-repo — new secrets go in those gitignored files, never in source, and a leaked commit must be scrubbed with git-filter-repo before pushing because a later remove-commit stays in history.
trigger: before committing or pushing lifx_controller changes that touch credentials
when adding a new secret or API key to lifx_controller

claim: lifx-controller's _scheduler_loop in scheduler.py had no try/except around its while body, so any transient exception permanently killed the scheduler thread while the FastAPI server kept serving 200s — detectable by the missing once-per-minute '[Scheduler] Checking schedules' heartbeat in /var/log/lifx-controller.log and frozen schedules.json last_run timestamps; sudo systemctl restart lifx-controller recovers, but a loop:true morning schedule with last_run=yesterday does not auto-resume.
trigger: when lights stop firing on schedule while /api/health and the web UI look fine
when /var/log/lifx-controller.log lacks the once-per-minute '[Scheduler] Checking schedules' heartbeat
when schedules.json last_run timestamps freeze

claim: The lifx-controller scheduler thread-death fix is applied and verified stable: _scheduler_loop is wrapped in try/except with a per-iteration heartbeat, /api/health now reports real scheduler liveness from heartbeat age (<30s), and /etc/logrotate.d/lifx-controller rotates the log with copytruncate — all changes uncommitted on master as of 2026-06-22.
trigger: when checking whether the lifx scheduler loop is wedged via curl localhost:8000/api/health
when '[Scheduler] ERROR in loop iteration (continuing)' appears in /var/log/lifx-controller.log
